lessons.title: Anthropic flags revenue surge to investors ahead of stock market debut
lessons.title_zh: 人工智慧巨頭 Anthropic 股票上市前夕向投資人展現亮眼營收成長

paragraphs.en: Artificial intelligence developer Anthropic reported that its quarterly revenue jumped by 45 percent to 16.8 billion dollars for the three months ending in September. The company, famous for creating Claude, shared these numbers with potential investors at its headquarters in San Francisco. This meeting took place as the firm prepares for an upcoming stock market debut before the end of the year.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智慧開發商 Anthropic 表示，在截至九月底的三個月內，其季度營收大幅成長 45%，達到 168 億美元。這家以打造 Claude 聞名的公司，在舊金山總部向潛在投資人透露了這些數據。該會議舉行之際，該公司正積極為預計於今年底前進行的掛牌上市預作準備。

paragraphs.en: Anthropic has experienced rapid financial growth throughout the year. Its revenue climbed from 4.7 billion dollars in the first quarter to 11.6 billion dollars in the second quarter. Furthermore, the company stated that it made a profit for the second consecutive quarter. Analysts closely watch Anthropic and its competitor OpenAI to measure how well the AI sector can fund its expensive technology.
paragraphs.zh: Anthropic 在今年經歷了快速的財務成長。其營收從第一季度的 47 億美元攀升至第二季度的 116 億美元。此外，該公司表示已連續第二個季度實現獲利。分析師密切關注 Anthropic 及其競爭對手 OpenAI，以評估人工智慧產業為其昂貴技術籌措資金的能力。

paragraphs.en: Despite these strong results, many global technology stocks recently faced heavy selling pressure. Shares of leading chip manufacturers like Nvidia, AMD, and Intel dropped sharply. In Asia, stock prices for Softbank, Samsung, and SK Hynix also fell substantially. Market worries increased after Broadcom head Hock Tan warned that extreme expectations have made some AI investing "almost like they are in a casino."
paragraphs.zh: 儘管有這些強勁的業績，全球許多科技股近期卻面臨沉重的賣壓。輝達（Nvidia）、超微（AMD）和英特爾（Intel）等晶片製造大廠的股價急遽下跌。在亞洲，軟銀、三星和 SK 海力士的股價也大幅下滑。博通（Broadcom）執行長陳福陽（Hock Tan）警告過高的預期讓部分 AI 投資「幾乎像是在賭場一樣」，此番言論進一步加深了市場的擔憂。

paragraphs.en: Besides financial challenges, safety issues remain a major concern for the industry. OpenAI chief Sam Altman announced that his firm will delay going public to address safety risks, even though it expects a future valuation above one trillion dollars. Similarly, Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei has urged developers to slow down their progress. Meanwhile, Anthropic continues to grow internationally, opening a new office in Singapore on Wednesday.
paragraphs.zh: 除了財務方面的挑戰，安全問題仍是該產業的主要隱憂。OpenAI 執行長阿特曼（Sam Altman）宣布，該公司將延後上市以處理安全問題，儘管外界預期其未來的估值將超過一兆美元。同樣地，Anthropic 執行長阿莫代（Dario Amodei）也呼籲開發者放慢研發步伐。在此同時，Anthropic 持續向全球擴張，並於週三在新加坡設立了新辦事處。

lessons.title: Wales has a school standards crisis. Will plans to fix it actually work?
lessons.title_zh: 威爾斯正面臨學校水準危機：補救計畫真的能奏效嗎？

paragraphs.en: In Wales, students recently moved into an impressive new school building in Merthyr Tydfil. However, behind this modern campus lies a serious crisis in the Welsh education system. In the latest Pisa tests, which measure the reading, maths, and science skills of 15-year-olds, Wales once again ranked the lowest among the four United Kingdom nations. According to global experts, Welsh students now lag about two years behind their English peers.
paragraphs.zh: 在威爾斯，學生們最近搬進了梅瑟蒂德菲爾一座令人印象深刻的全新校舍。然而，在這座現代化校園背後，威爾斯的教育體系卻面臨著嚴重危機。在最新一次衡量十五歲學生閱讀、數學和科學能力的國際學生評量計畫（PISA）中，威爾斯的排名再次於英國四個構成國中墊底。根據全球專家的說法，威爾斯學生的程度現在落後英格蘭同齡學生大約兩年。

paragraphs.en: This decline has sparked widespread debate across the nation. Over the past two decades, Welsh leaders took a different path from England by removing school ranking tables and standard exams. Although earlier ministers tried to bring back strict accountability after poor test results in 2010, many of those measures were later removed. Critics argue that Welsh schools have spent large amounts of public money without being held accountable for their outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 這項退步在全國引發了廣泛討論。在過去二十年間，威爾斯領導人採取了與英格蘭不同的做法，取消了學校排名榜和標準化測驗。儘管早期的部長在2010年糟糕的測驗成績後試圖恢復嚴格的績效責任制度，但其中許多措施隨後又被取消。批評者指出，威爾斯各校花費了大量公帑，卻沒有人因教學成效被要求負責。

paragraphs.en: Wales has also launched a major new curriculum that gives individual schools great freedom to decide what to teach. While the goal is to develop well-rounded students, educational experts warn this approach could create serious inconsistency. Many teachers feel overwhelmed because they are expected to design everything on their own without clear directions. Lucy Crehan warned that "it is the most disadvantaged pupils who could come off worst."
paragraphs.zh: 威爾斯還推行了一項重大的新課綱，賦予各學校極大自由來決定教學內容。雖然其目標是培育全方位發展的學生，但教育專家警告這種做法可能會導致各校品質嚴重不一致。許多教師感到不知所措，因為他們必須在缺乏明確指引的情況下獨自規劃一切。露西．克里漢警告說，「最弱勢的學生可能會受害最深。」

paragraphs.en: In addition, structural issues within local government make real improvement difficult. Former leaders point out that having twenty-two local councils oversee schools is inefficient, as some authorities are too small to offer adequate support. Research shows that disadvantaged pupils in Wales perform worse than similar students in England. As the new curriculum takes full effect, leaders face urgent pressure to raise learning standards before the next global tests in 2029.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，地方政府內部的結構性問題也讓真正的改革變得困難。前領導人指出，由二十二個地方議會管轄各校效率低落，因為有些地方機關規模太小，無法提供足夠支援。研究顯示，威爾斯弱勢學生的表現比英格蘭的同類學生更差。隨著新課綱全面落實，領導階層面臨著迫切的壓力，必須在2029年下一次全球測驗前提升學習標準。

grammar.explain: 使用形容詞或副詞的比較級搭配 than，表示兩者之間的程度差異。

lessons.title: MAC criticizes China’s sanctions aiming at election interference
lessons.title_zh: 陸委會批中國以制裁企圖介入台灣選舉

paragraphs.en: Taiwan’s Mainland Affairs Council (MAC) has strongly criticized China’s Taiwan Affairs Office (TAO) for penalizing a business owned by the father of Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) Legislator Puma Shen. The council stated that this sanction is an obvious attempt to pressure Taiwanese society and meddle in the island's democratic elections.
paragraphs.zh: 大陸委員會（陸委會）強烈批評中國國台辦對民進黨立委沈伯洋父親名下的企業實施制裁。陸委會指出，這項制裁顯然是企圖對台灣社會施壓並介入台灣的民主選舉。

paragraphs.en: This official reaction occurred after two Hong Kong newspapers reported that VWAY Co, owned by Shen’s father, Shen Tu-cheng, was still earning revenue in China. Another company run by him, Sicuens International, had already been sanctioned last June. In response, TAO spokesperson Chen Binhua announced that VWAY is now banned from cooperating with any Chinese organizations.
paragraphs.zh: 在兩家香港報紙報導沈伯洋父親沈土城擁有的「曜揚公司」仍在中國獲利後，陸委會發表了這項官方回應。沈土城經營的另一家公司「兆億」已於去年六月遭到制裁。國台辦發言人陳斌華隨後宣布，禁止曜揚公司與任何中國機構進行合作。

paragraphs.en: The MAC pointed out that Beijing follows a repeated strategy to influence Taiwan. First, media outlets connected to the Chinese government release targeted reports, and then the TAO announces formal sanctions. The council warned that Chinese authorities deliberately manipulate public opinion, label specific candidates, and exert economic pressure during election periods to coerce the public.
paragraphs.zh: 陸委會指出，北京當局慣用一套重複的策略來影響台灣。首先，與中國政府相關的媒體會發布針對性的報導，隨後國台辦再宣布正式制裁。該委員會警告，中國當局常在選舉期間刻意操弄輿論、為特定候選人貼標籤並施加經濟壓力，以此脅迫台灣民眾。

paragraphs.en: Puma Shen, who is running for Taipei mayor, dismissed the news as recycled claims that he has answered many times before. He explained that his family does business with Ecuador instead of China. Shen, who is already on a Chinese wanted list, remarked, “I will wait and see what else they can dish out,” regarding Beijing’s actions.
paragraphs.zh: 身為民進黨台北市長參選人的沈伯洋駁斥這些消息為炒冷飯的舊說法，並表示自己已多次回應。他解釋家族事業是與厄瓜多做生意，而非在中國境內運作。已被列入中國通緝名單的沈伯洋針對北京的舉動表示：「我倒要看看他們還能使出什麼招數。」

paragraphs.en: The DPP legislative caucus supported Shen, arguing that politicians who defend Taiwan most bravely always become the main targets of Chinese hostility. The caucus stressed that voters will see through these foreign political tricks, insisting that no democratic society would allow an external power to interfere with its local democratic votes.
paragraphs.zh: 民進黨立法院黨團也力挺沈伯洋，認為最勇敢捍衛台灣的政治人物往往會成為中國敵意的主要目標。黨團強調選民會識破這些外來政治伎倆，並堅持沒有任何民主社會會允許境外勢力干預本土的民主投票。

grammar.explain: 由「have/has + 過去分詞」構成，表示過去發生並持續到現在或對當前造成影響的動作。
grammar.example: Taiwan’s Mainland Affairs Council (MAC) has strongly criticized China’s Taiwan Affairs Office (TAO) for penalizing a business owned by the father of Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) Legislator Puma Shen.

grammar.point: 過去完成式之被動語態 (Past Perfect Passive)
grammar.explain: 由「had been + 過去分詞」構成，用來表達在過去某個特定時間點之前就已經發生的被動動作。
grammar.example: Another company run by him, Sicuens International, had already been sanctioned last June.

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的非限定子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 在專有名詞後以逗號隔開，使用關係代名詞 who 引導形容詞子句，提供先行詞的補充說明。
grammar.example: Puma Shen, who is running for Taipei mayor, dismissed the news as recycled claims that he has answered many times before.

lessons.title: Talks on Taiwan-Alaska LNG deal advance
lessons.title_zh: 台美 LNG 採購協議與外交國防動態進展

paragraphs.en: Taiwan is making steady progress in talks to buy liquefied natural gas from an Alaskan project, potentially investing up to US$4.4 billion. The Ministry of Economic Affairs stated that CPC Corporation, Taiwan would purchase 6 million tonnes of the gas each year once production begins.
paragraphs.zh: 台灣在購買阿拉斯加液化天然氣計畫的談話中正取得穩定進展，潛在投資金額高達 44 億美元。經濟部表示，台灣中油一旦生產開始，每年將購買 6 百萬噸的天然氣。

paragraphs.en: This partnership aims to diversify energy supplies and enhance national security. Because the location allows direct shipping across the Pacific Ocean, it offers an alternative route that helps reduce geopolitical risks.
paragraphs.zh: 這項合作夥伴關係旨在多元化能源供應並提升國家安全。由於地理位置允許直接透過太平洋運輸，它提供了有助於降低地緣政治風險的替代航線。

paragraphs.en: In other news regarding national defense, Taiwan is set to receive 500 Stinger missiles and 178 launchers by the end of the year. This shipment represents the first batch of a planned two-stage acquisition to strengthen air defense capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 在國防的其他消息方面，台灣預計在年底前接收 500 枚刺針飛彈與 178 發發射器。這批運送代表了旨在強化防空能力之規劃中兩階段採購的第一批。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, the Coast Guard Administration completed a historic diplomatic visit. Two vessels sailed to Palau for a joint patrol of the exclusive economic zone, setting a new record for their southernmost deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 同時，海巡署完成了一次歷史性的外交訪問。兩艘艦艇航行至帛琉進行專屬經濟區的聯合巡邏，為其最南端部署創下了新紀錄。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, the government is carefully monitoring online rumors concerning a potential disease outbreak spreading from Russia into China. Authorities are fully prepared to implement necessary border quarantine measures to protect public health.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，政府正密切監控有關潛在疾病從俄羅斯蔓延至中國的網路謠言。當局已全面準備好實施必要的邊境檢疫措施來保護公眾健康。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the European Parliament adopted an important recommendation supporting Taiwan's international participation. The document strongly rejects China's attempts to restrict Taiwan and describes the island as a valuable global partner.
paragraphs.zh: 最後，歐洲議會通過了一項支持台灣國際參與的重要建議案。該文件強烈拒絕中國限制台灣的企圖，並將這個島嶼描述為一個有價值的全球夥伴。

grammar.point: 現在分詞作修飾語 [Present Participle as Modifier]
grammar.explain: 用現在分詞短語來修飾前面的名詞，表達主動或進行的狀態。
grammar.example: Furthermore, the government is carefully monitoring online rumors concerning a potential disease outbreak spreading from Russia into China.

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的用 [Infinitive of Purpose]
grammar.explain: 使用「to + 動詞原形」來表達某個動作的目的。
grammar.example: Authorities are fully prepared to implement necessary border quarantine measures to protect public health.

lessons.title: Resource exploration to begin in Greenland: Trump
lessons.title_zh: 川普表示格陵蘭即將展開資源探勘

paragraphs.en: US President Donald Trump stated that oil, gas, and mineral exploration would soon begin in Greenland. He praised the arctic island as a very important location for the security of both the United States and Europe.
paragraphs.zh: 美國總統川普表示，格陵蘭很快將開始進行石油、天然氣和礦產探勘。他稱讚這個北極島嶼是美國與歐洲安全非常重要的地點。

paragraphs.en: Washington recently signed a security agreement with Greenland and Denmark leaders. This 10-page pact includes plans for the US to construct two military bases in southern and eastern Greenland.
paragraphs.zh: 華府最近與格陵蘭及丹麥領導人簽署了一項安全協議。這份10頁的條約包含了美國在格陵蘭南部與東部建造兩座軍事基地的計畫。

paragraphs.en: Greenland is situated on the shortest missile route between Russia and the US. Trump emphasized that the island offers a wonderful strategic location and holds massive untapped rare earth deposits.
paragraphs.zh: 格陵蘭位於俄羅斯與美國之間最短的飛彈航線上。川普強調，該島提供了絕佳的戰略位置，並擁有大量未開發的稀土礦藏。

paragraphs.en: In separate news, Taiwan Coast Guard vessels recently completed a diplomatic visit and a joint patrol in Palau. Meanwhile, Taiwan is scheduled to receive hundreds of Stinger missiles from the US by the end of the year to strengthen defense capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 在其他新聞方面，台灣海巡署船艦近日完成了對帛琉的訪問與聯合巡邏。同時，台灣預計在年底前接收數百枚來自美國的刺針飛彈以強化防衛能力。

paragraphs.en: The Taiwanese government is also closely watching online rumors about a pneumonic plague outbreak spreading from Russia into China. Authorities are fully prepared to enhance border quarantine measures to protect public health.
paragraphs.zh: 台灣政府也正密切關注網路有關肺鼠疫從俄羅斯蔓延至中國的謠言。當局已全面準備好加強邊境檢疫措施以保護公眾健康。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the European Parliament adopted a recommendation on political relations, strongly rejecting China's efforts to restrict Taiwan's participation in international organizations and global exchanges.
paragraphs.zh: 最後，歐洲議會通過了一項關於政治關係的建議案，強烈拒絕中國限制台灣參與國際組織與全球交流的企圖。

grammar.explain: 用來強調動作的承受者，結構為「be動詞 + 過去分詞 (V-pp)」。
grammar.example: This 10-page pact includes plans for the US to construct two military bases in southern and eastern Greenland.

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的用語 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用「to + 原形動詞」來表達做某事的目的。
grammar.example: Authorities are fully prepared to enhance border quarantine measures to protect public health.

grammar.explain: 用來修飾前方名詞的形容詞子句，常用which或that引導。
grammar.example: Finally, the European Parliament adopted a recommendation on political relations, strongly rejecting China's efforts to restrict Taiwan's participation in international organizations and global exchanges.

lessons.title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year
lessons.title_zh: 嗅探清除外來種「海嘔吐物」：蘇格蘭搜救犬榮獲年度動物獎

paragraphs.en: A six-year-old black Labrador named Sgiath from the Scottish Highlands has won the Animal of the Year award from the International Fund for Animal Welfare. Sgiath is believed to be the first dog in the UK trained to track down an invasive marine animal known as the carpet sea squirt, which is nicknamed "sea vomit."
paragraphs.zh: 一隻來自蘇格蘭高地、名叫 Sgiath 的六歲黑色拉布拉多犬，榮獲國際愛護動物基金會頒發的「年度動物獎」。Sgiath 被認為是英國第一隻受過專業訓練、專門搜尋被暱稱為「海嘔吐物」之外來海洋生物「大裝甲海鞘」的犬隻。

paragraphs.en: This organism, thought to come from Japan, first appeared in southern England and Wales in 2008. If left unmanaged, it can cover and kill native species by taking away essential nutrients. Marine biologist Dr. Martyn Kurr explained that this creature also clogs up fish farms and boat machinery, costing millions of pounds across Europe for cleanup efforts.
paragraphs.zh: 這種生物被認為源自日本，於2008年首次出現在英格蘭南部和威爾斯。如果不加以控制，牠們會奪走重要養分，並覆蓋、殺死本土物種。海洋生物學家馬丁．庫爾博士解釋，這種生物還會堵塞水產養殖箱網與船隻機械，使歐洲各地每年耗費數百萬英鎊進行清理。

paragraphs.en: Dr. Texa Sim, a marine ecologist, has cared for Sgiath since she was a puppy. Sgiath initially trained as a mountain rescue dog, where she barked to locate lost hikers. Dr. Sim was amazed by the dog's intelligence and wondered if her strong sense of smell could help marine conservation. Although sniffer dogs are common on land, using them in marine environments had rarely been explored.
paragraphs.zh: 海洋生態學家泰克莎．辛姆博士從 Sgiath 還是幼犬時就開始照顧牠。Sgiath 最初受訓為高山搜救犬，會以吠叫來標記迷途登山客的位置。辛姆博士對這隻狗的聰明才智感到驚奇，並好奇牠靈敏的嗅覺是否也能協助海洋保育。儘管偵搜犬在陸地上很常見，但在海洋環境中的應用卻鮮少有人探索。

paragraphs.en: During low tide, Sgiath walks along beaches and docks, sniffing through seaweed to detect the pest. While carpet sea squirts look like ordinary slime and are hard for humans to spot, Sgiath pinpoints them accurately. Instead of barking, she gives a calm signal. Dr. Sim explained, "It's a kind of a stillness, or a stare."
paragraphs.zh: 在退潮期間，Sgiath 會沿著海灘和碼頭走動，在海草中嗅聞以偵測這種害物。雖然大裝甲海鞘看起來就像普通黏液且人類難以察覺，但 Sgiath 卻能精準指出牠們的位置。不同於搜救時的吠叫，牠會給出平靜的訊號。辛姆博士說明：「那是一種靜止不動，或是凝視的狀態。」

paragraphs.en: Sgiath has already detected hundreds of colonies. Both Sgiath and Dr. Sim's younger Labrador, Uisage, work happily for treats and playtime. Marine scientists are excited about this success, noting that dogs can detect environmental threats before they spread out of control.
paragraphs.zh: Sgiath 至今已發現了數百個群落。Sgiath 和辛姆博士另一隻較年輕的拉布拉多犬 Uisage 都受到零食與玩耍的激勵而樂於工作。海洋科學家對此成果感到振奮，並指出狗狗能在環境威脅失控擴散之前及早察覺。

grammar.explain: 由「be 動詞 + 過去分詞 (p.p.)」構成，用於強調動作的承受者或客觀敘述事實。
grammar.example: Sgiath is believed to be the first dog in the UK trained to track down an invasive marine animal known as the carpet sea squirt, which is nicknamed "sea vomit."

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 在先行詞後加上逗號，並用關係代名詞（如 which）引導子句，用以提供補充性的額外資訊。
grammar.example: Sgiath is believed to be the first dog in the UK trained to track down an invasive marine animal known as the carpet sea squirt, which is nicknamed "sea vomit."

grammar.explain: 由「have / has + 過去分詞 (p.p.)」構成，表示從過去開始累積至今的經驗、成果或狀態。
grammar.example: Sgiath has already detected hundreds of colonies.

lessons.title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats
lessons.title_zh: 印度與中國並非盟友——但尼泊爾希望促成兩國聯手應對氣候威脅

paragraphs.en: At the recent UN General Assembly, Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah introduced an ambitious proposal to bring regional rivals India and China together. He suggested establishing a joint mechanism to tackle severe climate threats in the fragile Himalayan region. He urged nations to turn the Himalayas into a center of international cooperation rather than an area of divided information.
paragraphs.zh: 在最近的聯合國大會上，尼泊爾總理巴倫德拉·沙阿（Balendra Shah）提出了一項雄心勃勃的提議，希望將印度與中國這對區域競爭對手團結起來。他建議建立一個聯合機制，以應對喜馬拉雅山脆弱地區面臨的嚴峻氣候威脅。他敦促各國將喜馬拉雅山脈轉變為國際合作的中心，而非資訊破碎的邊界。

paragraphs.en: The environmental danger in the mountains is growing rapidly. Temperatures in the Himalayas are climbing faster than the global average, causing glaciers to shrink and permafrost to thaw. In addition, thousands of expanding glacial lakes now threaten downstream communities in Nepal, India, and Bhutan with sudden, destructive floods and landslides that cross national borders.
paragraphs.zh: 山區的環境危機正在迅速加劇。喜馬拉雅地區的氣溫上升速度高於全球平均水準，導致冰川萎縮與永凍土融化。此外，數以千計逐漸擴大的冰川湖，現在正以跨越國界的突發性破壞性洪水和土石流，威脅著尼泊爾、印度及不丹的下游社區。

paragraphs.en: However, working together is difficult because India and China share a long, disputed border that has witnessed military stand-offs. Past attempts at joint environmental research failed to make real progress. Furthermore, previous agreements regarding hydrological data have expired, and China has stopped sharing river information on the Brahmaputra and Sutlej.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，兩國合作極具難度，因為印度與中國擁有漫長且具爭議的邊界，且雙方曾多次爆發軍事對峙。過去進行聯合環境研究的嘗試未能取得實質進展。此外，以往有關水文數據的協議已到期，中國也已停止提供布拉馬普特拉河（Brahmaputra）及薩特萊傑河（Sutlej）的河流資訊。

paragraphs.en: National security remains a major barrier to cross-border cooperation. Analysts point out that scientific information about river flows and terrain can easily be viewed as strategic military intelligence by defense officials. Because both armies face each other along tense frontiers, governments are extremely cautious about exchanging sensitive data.
paragraphs.zh: 國家安全仍是跨境合作的一大障礙。分析人士指出，國防官員很容易將關於河流流量和地形的科學資訊視為戰略軍事情報。由於兩國軍隊在緊張的邊界兩側相互對峙，政府對於交流敏感數據抱持極度謹慎的態度。

paragraphs.en: Despite these obstacles, experts believe the countries can start with practical steps, such as identifying dangerous glacial lakes and setting up early warning systems. As natural disasters become more frequent, Nepal faces the difficult task of convincing its two powerful neighbors to set aside their disputes and confront a shared environmental crisis together.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管存在這些阻礙，專家認為各國可以從務實的步驟著手，例如確認高風險的冰川湖並建立早期預警系統。隨著自然災害變得日益頻繁，尼泊爾面臨著一項艱鉅的任務：說服這兩個強大的鄰國放下歧見，共同面對共同的環境危機。

grammar.point: 現在分詞引導的結果狀語 (Participle Clause of Result)
grammar.explain: 使用「逗號 + 現在分詞（causing...）」結構，用來說明主句事件所帶來的後續結果或影響。
grammar.example: Temperatures in the Himalayas are climbing faster than the global average, causing glaciers to shrink and permafrost to thaw.

grammar.explain: 由「情態助動詞 + be + 過去分詞」構成，強調動作的承受對象而非執行者。
grammar.example: Analysts point out that scientific information about river flows and terrain can easily be viewed as strategic military intelligence by defense officials.

grammar.point: 動名詞作介系詞受詞 (Gerund as Object of a Preposition)
grammar.explain: 介系詞（如 of）後面必須接名詞或動名詞（V-ing），在此用來詳細說明名詞 task 的具體內容。
grammar.example: Nepal faces the difficult task of convincing its two powerful neighbors to set aside their disputes and confront a shared environmental crisis together.

lessons.title: For the future of green politics, look beyond the Green party | Zoe Williams
lessons.title_zh: 著眼綠色政治的未來，不能只看綠黨

paragraphs.en: Earlier this summer in King's Lynn and West Norfolk, a local council faced a fierce debate over climate change. A Reform UK councillor, Austen Moore, tried to cancel a climate emergency declaration that was originally passed in 2021. Ironically, the council had to call off the first meeting because of extreme heat in the chamber. Although other members chose to vote down Moore's proposal the following week, similar efforts by right-wing politicians have succeeded in other areas. In Kent, one councillor even claimed that reducing carbon emissions was dangerous.
paragraphs.zh: 今年初夏，在金斯林和西諾福克，當地市議會面臨了一場關於氣候變遷的激烈辯論。英國改革黨議員奧斯汀·摩爾試圖廢除最初於2021年通過的氣候緊急狀態宣言。諷刺的是，由於會議廳內氣溫過高，議會不得不取消第一場會議。儘管其他議員在隔週選擇否決摩爾的提案，但右翼政客在其他地區類似的舉動卻獲得了成功。在肯特郡，甚至有一位議員聲稱減少碳排放是危險的。

paragraphs.en: Right-wing populists often argue that policies like net zero and low-emission zones are too expensive. They claim these environmental measures are luxury ideas held by wealthy elites who ignore the daily struggles of ordinary citizens. Because these arguments are repeated constantly, they gain support from people who worry about the rising cost of living and economic uncertainty.
paragraphs.zh: 右翼民粹主義者經常爭辯說，淨零排放和低排放區等政策過於昂貴。他們聲稱這些環保措施是富裕精英階層的奢侈想法，忽視了普通公民的日常生活困境。因為這些論點被不斷重複，進而獲得了那些對日益上漲的生活成本和經濟不確定性感到擔憂的人們支持。

paragraphs.en: However, about 68 percent of British people still support action on climate change. The Green Party alone cannot represent this majority. Political thinkers Caroline Lucas and Rupert Read suggest promoting "eco-popularism." Instead of using bitter political divisions, leaders should offer practical solutions that directly improve daily lives, such as cheaper green energy, food security, and protection against extreme weather.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，仍有大約百分之六十八的英國人支持採取氣候行動。光靠綠黨本身無法代表這大多數人。政治思想家卡羅琳·盧卡斯和魯珀特·里德建議提倡「生態平民主義」。領導人應提供能直接改善日常生活的務實解方，例如更便宜的綠色能源、糧食安全以及對極端天氣的防護，而不是製造痛苦的政治對立。

paragraphs.en: To win public trust, politicians across different parties must connect climate action with real community needs. Simply talking about global disasters often makes citizens feel hopeless and weak. Instead, local and practical projects should be celebrated. Environmentalists must address economic fears directly so that green policies can protect both the planet and ordinary families.
paragraphs.zh: 為了贏得大眾信任，不同政黨的政治人物必須將氣候行動與社區的真實需求連結起來。僅僅大談全球災害往往只會讓公民感到絕望與無力。相反地，地方且務實的計畫應該受到肯定與推廣。環保人士必須正視經濟恐懼，如此一來綠色政策才能同時保護地球與一般家庭。

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 句首使用「to + 原形動詞」結構，用以說明主要子句動作的目的或動機。
grammar.example: To win public trust, politicians across different parties must connect climate action with real community needs.

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 使用關係代名詞 who 引導子句，用來補充說明前面的先行詞 wealthy elites。
grammar.example: They claim these environmental measures are luxury ideas held by wealthy elites who ignore the daily struggles of ordinary citizens.

grammar.point: 讓步副詞子句 (Adverb Clause of Concession)
grammar.explain: 由從屬連接詞 although 引導副詞子句，表示「雖然、儘管」，與後方主要子句形成對比。
grammar.example: Although other members chose to vote down Moore's proposal the following week, similar efforts by right-wing politicians have succeeded in other areas.

lessons.title: Plan unveiled to increase share of land farmed organically in England to 10%
lessons.title_zh: 英格蘭公布新計畫：目標2036年前將有機農地比例提高至10%

paragraphs.en: The UK government has set a target to increase the share of land farmed organically in England to 10% by 2036. At present, only 3.4% of England's agricultural land is organic, which is one of the lowest proportions in Europe. In contrast, France already farms 10.4% of its land organically and aims to reach 18% by 2027.
paragraphs.zh: 英國政府已設定目標，計畫在2036年之前將英格蘭有機農地的比例提高至10%。目前，英格蘭僅有3.4%的農業用地採用有機耕作，是歐洲比例最低的地區之一。相比之下，法國已有10.4%的土地實施有機耕種，並計畫在2027年達到18%。

paragraphs.en: This new strategy took more than three years to prepare. It highlights public procurement, such as supplying food to schools and hospitals, as a major opportunity for expansion. Environment Secretary Angela Eagle explained that organic farming should not be viewed merely as a niche market, because consumers now pay more attention to food sources and production methods.
paragraphs.zh: 這項新策略歷時三年多籌備。該計畫將學校與醫院等機構的公共採購，視為擴大市場的重要契機。環境大臣安吉拉·伊格爾（Angela Eagle）解釋，有機農業不應僅被視為小眾市場，因為消費者如今越來越關注食物來源與生產方式。

paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, serious worries remain regarding financial support. In September, a key government farming fund ran out in just six hours, leaving thousands of applicants empty-handed. Rob Haward, an organic business leader, stressed that reliable grants are necessary for growers to make long-term investments. Gareth Morgan from the Soil Association also called for the urgent reopening of funding to support the shift.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，各界對資金補助仍存在嚴重疑慮。今年九月，一筆關鍵的政府農業基金在短短六小時內就被申請一空，導致數千名申請者空手而歸。有機企業負責人羅布·哈沃德（Rob Haward）強調，農民需要可靠的補助金才能進行長期投資。土壤協會的加雷斯·摩根（Gareth Morgan）也呼籲應緊急重新開放補助，以協助農場轉型。

paragraphs.en: Experts believe that expanding organic land could bring down consumer prices if it becomes mainstream. However, Martin Lines from the Nature Friendly Farming Network noted that farmers cannot rely solely on government money. He argued that private companies must invest and offer fairer prices for local crops.
paragraphs.zh: 專家認為，如果有機食品成為主流，擴大有機土地面積將有助於降低消費者負擔的價格。然而，環境友善農業網絡的馬丁·萊恩斯（Martin Lines）指出，農民不能完全依賴政府資金。他主張民間企業也必須投資，並為本地農產品提供更合理的收購價格。

paragraphs.en: Supporters also point out that organic farming strengthens climate resilience. Organic growers cope better with severe heat and drought. Furthermore, because they do not depend on chemical products, they are protected from skyrocketing fertilizer costs caused by the war in Iran. The National Farmers' Union added that boosting local production will reduce reliance on foreign food imports.
paragraphs.zh: 支持者還指出，有機耕作能強化應對氣候變遷的韌性。有機農民能更好地因應極端酷熱與乾旱。此外，由於他們不依賴化學物質，因而免受伊朗戰爭所引發的肥料價格暴漲衝擊。全國農民聯盟補充表示，促進本土生產將能減少對外國進口食品的依賴。

grammar.explain: 由「have / has + 過去分詞」構成，表示過去已經完成且持續對現在產生影響的動作。
grammar.example: The UK government has set a target to increase the share of land farmed organically in England to 10% by 2036.

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 逗號後使用「which」引導子句，用來對前方的主句事實做補充說明。
grammar.example: At present, only 3.4% of England's agricultural land is organic, which is one of the lowest proportions in Europe.

grammar.point: 助動詞被動語態 (Passive Voice with Modal Verbs)
grammar.explain: 由「助動詞 + be + 過去分詞」組成，表示某事物「應該被／不該被…」對待或看待。
grammar.example: Environment Secretary Angela Eagle explained that organic farming should not be viewed merely as a niche market, because consumers now pay more attention to food sources and production methods.

lessons.title: Mont Blanc, the ‘roof of Europe’, loses more than a metre of height in a year
lessons.title_zh: 「歐洲屋脊」白朗峰一年內高度縮減超過一公尺

paragraphs.en: Western Europe's highest mountain has recently decreased in height by over a meter. Surveyors announced that the peak of this famous French mountain now stands at 4,807.47 meters above sea level. This measurement places the famous geographic landmark 1.29 meters lower than its recorded height from the previous year.
paragraphs.zh: 西歐最高峰的身高最近減少了一公尺以上。測量人員宣布，這座著名的法國山峰現在海拔高度為4,807.47公尺。這項測量結果使這個著名的地理地標比前一年的記錄高度低了1.29公尺。

paragraphs.en: Although the solid rock beneath is around 4,792 meters tall, the snowy summit constantly shifts. Factors like heat, wind, and precipitation alter the thickness of the ice cap on top. Experts collected data during an expedition last month, recording a height that was 1.88 meters higher than the lowest levels found in recent memory back in 2023.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然下方堅硬的岩石大約有4,792公尺高，但積雪的山頂卻在不斷變動。熱氣、風和降水等因素改變了頂部冰帽的厚度。專家們在上個月的考察中收集了數據，記錄到比2023年近期記憶中的最低水平高出1.88公尺的高度。

paragraphs.en: Professional surveyors have monitored the peak regularly using advanced satellite technology. They also deployed drones to build a detailed model of the ice and snow layer. Historical records show that the summit has dropped by 3.43 meters since reaching a high point in 2007.
paragraphs.zh: 專業測量人員利用先進的衛星技術定期監測山峰。他們還部署無人機來建立冰雪層的詳細模型。歷史記錄顯示，自2007年達到高點以來，山頂已經下降了3.43公尺。

paragraphs.en: Experts advise people not to connect yearly altitude fluctuations directly to the rapid loss of regional ice caused by pollution. As Jean des Garets noted, warming trends are clearly visible elsewhere, but "climate change doesn't seem to have the same impact above 4,000 meters" for now.
paragraphs.zh: 專家建議人們不要將每年的高度波動直接與汙染造成的區域冰層快速流失連結起來。正如尚·德加雷所指出的，變暖趨勢在其他地方清晰可見，但目前「氣候變遷似乎在四千公尺以上沒有產生相同的影響」。

grammar.explain: 用形容詞或副詞的比較級形態來對比兩者之間的差異。
grammar.example: This measurement places the famous geographic landmark 1.29 meters lower than its recorded height from the previous year.

grammar.explain: 用來表達過去發生的動作對現在造成的影響或持續到現在的狀態。
grammar.example: Professional surveyors have monitored the peak regularly using advanced satellite technology.

grammar.explain: 使用現在分詞或過去分詞來簡化副詞子句，表達同時發生的動作或補充說明。
grammar.example: Experts collected data during an expedition last month, recording a height that was 1.88 meters higher than the lowest levels found in recent memory back in 2023.

lessons.title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'
lessons.title_zh: 首相：羅osebank與Jackdaw油氣田開發決定即將出爐

paragraphs.en: Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced that the government will soon decide whether to approve two major oil and gas fields in the North Sea. These controversial projects, known as Rosebank and Jackdaw, have sparked intense debates between industry groups and environmental activists over the past few years.
paragraphs.zh: 首相安迪·伯恩罕宣布，政府將很快決定是否批准北海的兩個大型油氣田。這些備受爭議的計畫被稱為Rosebank與Jackdaw，在過去幾年中引發了產業界與環保人士之間的激烈辯論。

paragraphs.en: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch criticized the prime minister for delaying the process and urged him to take action immediately. She argued that approving these projects earlier could have provided British gas to warm homes during the winter. In response, Burnham explained that his administration had to fix previous legal problems left by the former government.
paragraphs.zh: 保守黨領袖凱米·巴德諾批評首相拖延流程並敦促他立即採取行動。她主張早日批准這些計畫本可以在冬季提供英國天然氣來為家庭取暖。作為回應，伯恩罕解釋說，他的政府必須修復前政府留下的先前法律問題。

paragraphs.en: Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh stated that all necessary information regarding the Jackdaw gas field has been thoroughly reviewed, making an official choice imminent. Meanwhile, the assessment for the Rosebank oil and gas field requires a bit more time before a final verdict is reached.
paragraphs.zh: 能源大臣米亞塔·法恩布利表示，關於Jackdaw天然氣田的所有必要資訊都已經過徹底審查，這意味著官方抉擇即將到來。同時，針對Rosebank油氣田的評估在做出最終裁決之前還需要多一點時間。

paragraphs.en: The legal troubles surrounding these sites began when the Court of Session in Edinburgh ruled that previous approvals were unlawful. The court pointed out that the former government failed to consider the climate impacts of burning the extracted fossil fuels. Environmentalists strongly oppose the drilling because it hampers emission reduction goals, whereas industry supporters claim it is vital for national energy security and jobs.
paragraphs.zh: 圍繞這些場址的法律麻煩始於愛丁堡的最高民事法院裁定先前的批准不合法。法院指出，前政府未能考慮燃燒開採出的化石燃料所帶來的氣候影響。環保人士強烈反對鑽探，因為它妨礙了減排目標，而業界支持者則聲稱這對國家能源安全與就業至關重要。

grammar.explain: 當句子的主語是動作的接受者時，使用「be動詞 + 過去分詞」來表達被動語態。
grammar.example: These controversial projects, known as Rosebank and Jackdaw, have sparked intense debates between industry groups and environmental activists over the past few years.

grammar.explain: 用來表示過去發生的動作對現在造成的影響，或持續到現在的狀態，結構為「have/has + 過去分詞」。
grammar.example: These controversial projects, known as Rosebank and Jackdaw, have sparked intense debates between industry groups and environmental activists over the past few years.

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的用語 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用「to + 原形動詞」置於句中或句尾，用來表達某個動作的目的。
grammar.example: She argued that approving these projects earlier could have provided British gas to warm homes during the winter.

lessons.title: Hands-on with the Ocarina of Time remake, the most ornate Zelda game ever made
lessons.title_zh: 實機體驗《時之笛》重製版：史上最華麗細緻的薩爾達傳說遊戲

paragraphs.en: After the massive box-office success of recent Mario movies, Nintendo is preparing for a Zelda movie next April. To keep fans excited, the company is releasing a remake of its 1998 masterpiece, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, for the Switch 2 on November 5. While other game publishers are avoiding this release window to dodge Grand Theft Auto VI, Nintendo offers a family-friendly alternative to that crime epic.
paragraphs.zh: 在近期瑪利歐電影取得巨大的票房成功之後，任天堂正為明年四月即將推出的薩爾達電影做準備。為了維持粉絲的熱情，該公司將於十一月五日在 Switch 2 上推出其 1998 年經典名作《薩爾達傳說：時之笛》的重製版。雖然其他遊戲發行商紛紛避開這個發行檔期以躲避《俠盜獵車手 VI》，但任天堂卻為這部犯罪史詩提供了一個適合全家同樂的替代選擇。

paragraphs.en: Visually, the new game keeps its classic artistic style while adding incredible details. For instance, Link's green outfit now displays realistic fabrics, and fairies have furry bodies with mosaic wings. However, these ornate environments can occasionally overwhelm players. During a 90-minute trial, a reporter even missed an important dungeon key in the Forest Temple because the rich backgrounds distracted the eye.
paragraphs.zh: 在視覺方面，這款新遊戲保留了其經典的藝術風格，同時增添了令人驚嘆的細節。例如，林克的綠色服裝現在展現出逼真的布料質感，精靈則擁有毛茸茸的身軀與馬賽克般的翅膀。然而，這些華麗繁複的環境有時會讓玩家應接不暇。在一次九十分鐘的試玩中，一名記者甚至在森林神殿中漏掉了一把推進關卡的重要鑰匙，因為豐富的背景細節分散了注意力。

paragraphs.en: In contrast to the huge visual makeover, the gameplay mechanics remain mostly traditional. Nintendo chose not to change the core elements that originally revolutionized 3D gaming. Nevertheless, players will notice helpful modern touches, such as a menu quest log called Threads of Time and an interface similar to Breath of the Wild.
paragraphs.zh: 與巨大的視覺改造相比，遊戲的操作機制大多保持傳統。任天堂選擇不改變最初徹底變革 3D 遊戲的核心要素。儘管如此，玩家仍會注意到一些實用的現代化設計，例如名為「Threads of Time」的選單任務日誌，以及類似於《曠野之息》的使用者介面。

paragraphs.en: The controls also introduce manual jumping and sprinting, making movement smoother and enabling players to take clever shortcuts. Even with these new options, the game remains a focused, linear adventure rather than a vast open world. You can still switch back to the classic automatic jumping if you prefer nostalgia.
paragraphs.zh: 控制方面也加入了手動跳躍與衝刺功能，使動作更加流暢，並讓玩家能夠利用巧妙的捷徑。即便有了這些新選項，這款遊戲依然是一場聚焦的線性冒險，而非廣闊的開放世界。如果你更偏好懷舊感，依然可以切換回經典的自動跳躍模式。

paragraphs.en: Overall, launching this polished remake is a brilliant strategic move before the Zelda movie arrives. With extraordinary production values, Nintendo aims to attract both veteran gamers and curious newcomers. While the game is visually stunning, players will soon discover whether its updated journey feels just as rewarding as the original.
paragraphs.zh: 整體而言，在薩爾達電影上映前推出這款精緻的重製版是一項高明的策略。憑藉極高的製作水準，任天堂旨在同時吸引資深老玩家與好奇的新手。雖然這款遊戲在視覺上令人驚豔，但玩家很快就能發現其翻新後的旅程是否如原作般令人感到充實與值得。

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用不定詞片語「to + 原形動詞」置於句首作副詞，用以表示主要子句動作的目的或原因。
grammar.example: To keep fans excited, the company is releasing a remake of its 1998 masterpiece, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, for the Switch 2 on November 5.

grammar.point: 讓步副詞子句 (Adverb Clause of Concession with While)
grammar.explain: 連接詞 while 可引導讓步副詞子句，表示「雖然、儘管」，用以對比兩個同時存在的情況或事實。
grammar.example: While other game publishers are avoiding this release window to dodge Grand Theft Auto VI, Nintendo offers a family-friendly alternative to that crime epic.

grammar.explain: 逗號後使用現在分詞片語簡化對等子句，用以表達主句動作所帶來的伴隨狀況或接續結果。
grammar.example: The controls also introduce manual jumping and sprinting, making movement smoother and enabling players to take clever shortcuts.

lessons.title: Defiance or denial? Inside Manchester City’s bubble, decked with inflatable bananas
lessons.title_zh: 反抗還是逃避？直擊曼城滿是充氣香蕉的自我世界

paragraphs.en: Manchester City recently faced severe criticism after being found guilty of over 100 charges concerning financial breaches. While many critics called the English club cheaters, team leaders denied the accusations, appealed the decision, and claimed they were victims of an unfair hunt. However, inside Etihad Stadium before a Champions League match against Paris Saint-Germain (PSG), the atmosphere felt like an alternative world where nothing was wrong.
paragraphs.zh: 曼徹斯特城隊（曼城）在被判定違反100多項財務指控後，近期面臨嚴厲的批評。儘管許多批評者稱這支英格蘭俱樂部為騙子，但球隊高層否認了指控、提出上訴，並堅稱自己是不公搜捕下的受害者。然而，在伊蒂哈德球場對陣巴黎聖日耳曼（PSG）的歐冠比賽前，球場內的氣氛宛如一個一切正常的另類世界。

paragraphs.en: Instead of crying over potential punishments like point deductions or relegation, supporters displayed strong optimism. Hundreds of inflatable yellow bananas appeared among the crowd. This unique tradition started in the 1980s when the club was relegated to a lower division, and fans created funny nicknames to lighten the mood. Decades later, these toy bananas served as symbols of humor and loyalty during this modern crisis.
paragraphs.zh: 球迷們沒有因為積分扣除或遭到降級等潛在處罰而哭泣，反而展現出強烈的樂觀態度。數百個充氣黃色香蕉出現在人群之中。這個獨特的傳統始於1980年代，當時該俱樂部降級至次級聯賽，球迷便透過取搞笑綽號來緩和氣氛。數十年後，這些玩具香蕉在當前的危機中，成為幽默與忠誠的象徵。

paragraphs.en: During the match, City suffered a painful 4-2 loss to PSG, but the fans continued to support their players. Interestingly, PSG manager Luis Enrique expressed rare support, hoping City would avoid harsh sanctions. Former manager Pep Guardiola, who recently left after winning many trophies, was also seen in the stands. His sudden return gave fans a reason to cheer and encouraged everyone to trust the club's leadership.
paragraphs.zh: 比賽期間，曼城以2比4慘敗給PSG，但球迷仍持續為球員打氣。有趣的是，PSG總教練路易斯·恩里克表達了罕見的支持，希望曼城能免於嚴厲的制裁。在帶領球隊拿下諸多獎盃後剛於今夏離隊的前教練佩普·瓜迪奧拉也現身看台。他的驚喜現身讓球迷大聲歡呼，並鼓勵大家要信任俱樂部的領導層。

paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, stepping outside the stadium brings harsh realities back into view. When reporters asked difficult questions, supporters simply answered that people should wait for the appeal. Yet, ignoring serious accusations cannot make them disappear. As City continues to play domestic matches against rivals who want justice, the club faces its greatest test, and no amount of plastic toys can guarantee safety.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管如此，走出球場外，殘酷的現實便再度浮現。當記者提出棘手的問題時，球迷們僅簡單回應大家應該等待上訴結果。然而，忽視嚴重的指控並不能使問題消失。隨著曼城繼續在國內賽事中面對渴望伸張正義的對手，該俱樂部正面臨嚴峻考驗，而再多的塑膠玩具也無法保證安全過關。

grammar.explain: 用於強調動作的接受者而非執行者，結構為「be動詞 + 過去分詞」。
grammar.example: Manchester City recently faced severe criticism after being found guilty of over 100 charges concerning financial breaches.

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 使用逗號隔開關係代名詞 who 引導的子句，為先行詞提供補充說明，省略後主要子句仍語意完整。
grammar.example: Former manager Pep Guardiola, who recently left after winning many trophies, was also seen in the stands.

grammar.point: 動名詞當主詞 (Gerund as Subject)
grammar.explain: 將動詞加上 -ing 轉變為名詞功能，在句中作主詞使用，視為單數。
grammar.example: Yet, ignoring serious accusations cannot make them disappear.

lessons.title: OpenAI accuses former employee of leaking intel on AI device to Apple
lessons.title_zh: OpenAI指控前員工洩露AI設備機密給蘋果

paragraphs.en: OpenAI recently accused a former worker of stealing intellectual property about an unreleased gadget and giving parts of that data to Apple. According to court papers filed on Wednesday, this person previously worked for Apple, spent six months at OpenAI, and then returned to Apple.
paragraphs.zh: OpenAI最近指控一名舊員工竊取有關一款未發布之小工具的智慧財產權，並將部分數據交給蘋果。根據週三提交的法院文件，這個人先前曾在蘋果工作，在OpenAI待了六個月，隨後又回到了蘋果。

paragraphs.en: The lawsuit claims that the individual downloaded over one hundred secret files to personal accounts right before leaving. These items contained design details and manufacturing information regarding the new device. The very last file transfer happened on his final day at the firm in June.
paragraphs.zh: 訴訟聲稱，該個人在離開前不久將一百多個機密檔案下載到個人帳戶中。這些項目包含關於新設備的設計細節與製造資訊。最後一次檔案傳輸發生在六月份他在該公司的最後一天。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, OpenAI stated that the worker presented product plans to top Apple leaders. Apple reportedly used this knowledge to push forward into AI products. However, Apple mentioned to CNN that it found zero proof supporting these claims and has strict rules to prevent workers from using past confidential materials.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，OpenAI指出該員工向蘋果高層展示了產品計劃。據報導，蘋果利用這些知識來推動AI產品。然而，蘋果向美國有線電視新聞網（CNN）表示，其未發現任何支持這些指控的證據，並且有嚴格規定以防止員工使用過去的機密資料。

paragraphs.en: This dispute is part of a larger legal battle that Apple started against OpenAI in July. Apple claimed that OpenAI stole trade secrets to build gadgets, which OpenAI denied. Both tech giants are currently competing fiercely to develop advanced artificial intelligence hardware devices.
paragraphs.zh: 這場爭端是蘋果於七月份對OpenAI發起之更大規模法律戰的一部分。蘋果聲稱OpenAI竊取商業機密來建造小工具，而OpenAI對此予以否認。這兩家科技巨頭目前正激烈競賽以開發先進的人工智慧硬體設備。

grammar.explain: 當主詞是動作的承受者時，使用「be動詞 + 過去分詞」來表達被動語態。
grammar.example: According to court papers filed on Wednesday, this person previously worked for Apple, spent six months at OpenAI, and then returned to Apple.

grammar.explain: 使用關係代名詞來修飾前面的名詞，提供更多補充資訊。
grammar.example: The lawsuit claims that the individual downloaded over one hundred secret files to personal accounts right before leaving.

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的用 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用「to + 原形動詞」來表達某個動作的目的或意圖。
grammar.example: Apple claimed that OpenAI stole trade secrets to build gadgets, which OpenAI denied.

lessons.title: The fight between the SEC and LSU isn’t over and the Tigers still could be kicked out of the conference
lessons.title_zh: SEC與LSU之爭未歇，這所大學仍面臨被逐出聯盟的可能

paragraphs.en: The legal battle between the Southeastern Conference and Louisiana State University continues as the conference filed a court response on Tuesday. The SEC stated that the dispute remains active because the university continues to challenge its rules regarding professional players.
paragraphs.zh: 東南聯盟與路易斯安那州立大學之間的法律戰仍在持續，因該聯盟於週二提交了法院回應。SEC表示爭端依然活躍，因為該大學持續挑戰其關於職業球員的規則。

paragraphs.en: The conflict began when men's basketball coach Will Wade tried to add multiple players who had previous NBA draft involvement. This directly violated the conference policy which bans athletes who have declared for professional drafts without proper withdrawal.
paragraphs.zh: 衝突始於男子籃球教練Will Wade試圖網羅多名有NBA選秀經歷的球員。這直接違反了聯盟政策，該政策禁止未依規定撤回的職業選秀運動員參賽。

paragraphs.en: Although the coach announced that one player, R.J. Luis, was not on the roster, he expressed confidence that other players like Saliou Niang and Brice Dessert would become eligible. Commissioner Greg Sankey made it clear that the league is deeply uncomfortable with these actions.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管教練宣佈球員R.J. Luis不在名單上，但他表示對Saliou Niang和Brice Dessert等其他球員能獲得資格充滿信心。聯盟總裁Greg Sankey明確表示，聯盟對這些行為感到極度不安。

paragraphs.en: The league previously secured new disciplinary rules, including heavy fines and coach suspensions, to deal with schools that break player policies. While expelling LSU is unlikely due to its economic value, the SEC wants to keep its legal options open.
paragraphs.zh: 聯盟先前制定了新的紀律規則，包括重罰和教練禁賽，以處理違反球員政策的學校。儘管基於其經濟價值，將LSU驅逐出門的可能性不大，但SEC仍希望保留其法律選擇。

grammar.explain: 使用關代詞來修飾前面的名詞，補充說明其特徵。
grammar.example: This directly violated the conference policy which bans athletes who have declared for professional drafts without proper withdrawal.

grammar.explain: 當主詞是動作的承受者時，使用「be + 過去分詞」的句型。
grammar.example: Although the coach announced that one player, R.J. Luis, was not on the roster, he expressed confidence that other players like Saliou Niang and Brice Dessert would become eligible.

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的用 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用「to + 原形動詞」來表達做某事的目的。
grammar.example: The league previously secured new disciplinary rules, including heavy fines and coach suspensions, to deal with schools that break player policies.

lessons.title: Philadelphia Eagles fans flock to the bar that brings the City of Brotherly Love to London
lessons.title_zh: 費城老鷹隊球迷湧入將「兄弟之愛之城」帶到倫敦的酒吧

paragraphs.en: When JP Teti moved from South Philadelphia to London, he noticed that his new home lacked the unique regional cuisine and classic dive bars he loved. He missed iconic foods like cheesesteaks and buffalo wings. Realizing he needed to take action, he decided to quit his corporate job and launch a business to bring authentic American culture to the UK.
paragraphs.zh: 當JP Teti從費城南部搬到倫敦時，他注意到他的新家缺少他所喜愛的獨特地區美食和經典平價酒吧。他懷念像起司牛肉堡和水牛城辣雞翅這樣的標誌性食物。意識到自己需要採取行動，他決定辭去公司的工作並創業，將正宗的美國文化帶到英國。

paragraphs.en: In 2018, Teti opened the first Passyunk Avenue in London, which happened to coincide with the Philadelphia Eagles bringing the Super Bowl trophy to the city. This lucky timing helped the business grow into a popular destination. Teti wanted to offer Europeans interested in American culture an immersive experience and a welcoming atmosphere.
paragraphs.zh: 2018年，Teti在倫敦開了第一家Passyunk Avenue，這正好碰上費城老鷹隊將超級盃獎盃帶到該市。這個幸運的時間點幫助這家店成長為一個熱門目的地。Teti希望為對美國文化感興趣的歐洲人提供沉浸式體驗和溫馨的氛圍。

paragraphs.en: Sports are a vital part of Philadelphia culture, serving as a powerful vehicle to tell its story. Recently, thousands of fans flocked to Passyunk Avenue as London hosted events celebrating the Philadelphia Eagles. The streets filled with retro jerseys, delicious food, and joyful chants before the big game.
paragraphs.zh: 體育是費城文化的重要部分，也是講述其故事的強大載體。最近，當倫敦舉辦慶祝費城老鷹隊的活動時，成千上萬的球迷湧入Passyunk Avenue。在大比賽開始前，街道上充滿了復古球衣、美味的食物和歡樂的口號。

paragraphs.en: Reflecting on his journey, Teti remembered feeling lonely and doubtful during difficult days of street trading. Seeing massive crowds gather together years later made all his hard work and risks completely worthwhile. Through his bars, he successfully created an outpost of hope and community for people far from home.
paragraphs.zh: 回顧他的心路歷程，Teti想起在街頭販售的艱難日子裡，曾感到孤獨和懷疑。幾年后看到巨大的人群聚集在一起，使得他所有的努力和冒險完全值得。透過他的酒吧，他成功為遠離家鄉的人們打造了一個希望與社群的前哨站。

lessons.title: Look of the Week: Ayo Edebiri’s swan silhouette reimagines the bustle
lessons.title_zh: 本週最佳穿搭：艾yo·艾德比瑞的天鵝輪廓重新演繹古典襯裙

paragraphs.en: Award-winning actor Ayo Edebiri recently attended a special screening for her upcoming movie titled Clarissa at the London Film Festival. For this public event, the talented star wore a sophisticated outfit from the famous brand Chanel. Her look combined a sleek black column skirt with minimalist high heels, showing a modern yet elegant fashion sense.
paragraphs.zh: 曾獲獎的演員艾yo·艾德比瑞最近出席在倫敦影展舉辦的新電影《Clarissa》特別放映會。在這場公開活動中，這位才華洋溢的明星穿著知名品牌香奈兒的精緻服裝。她的造型結合了俐落的黑色直筒裙與極簡風格的高跟鞋，展現出時尚卻又優雅的品味。

paragraphs.en: The outfit looked simple at first glance, but it featured a unique creamy top. This sleeveless garment had a voluminous hem that resembled bird feathers. In addition, her dangling earrings added a pop of vibrant color to match her bright lipstick. Her styled hair featured cascading braids that framed her face beautifully.
paragraphs.zh: 這套服裝乍看之下很簡單，但卻有一件獨特的乳白色上衣。這件無袖衣物有著像鳥類羽毛般蓬鬆的下擺。此外，她下垂的耳環增添了亮麗的色彩，與她明亮的口紅互相呼應。她造型過的頭髮有著如瀑布般垂墜的編髮，完美地襯托出她的臉龐。

paragraphs.en: Working closely with her personal stylist, Edebiri always manages to make high fashion look relaxed and youthful instead of stiff. Although the gorgeous outfit originally came from a collection inspired by fairy tales and woodland magic, it also created a distinct bird silhouette. When viewed from the side, the design presented a modern version of a traditional bustle.
paragraphs.zh: 艾德比瑞與個人造型師密切合作，總是能把高級時裝穿得輕鬆且充滿年輕活力，而不是顯得拘謹。雖然這套華麗的服裝原本來自靈感取自童話與森林魔法的系列，但它也創造出獨特的鳥類輪廓。從側面看時，這項設計呈現了現代版的傳統臀墊裝飾。

paragraphs.en: This bird-inspired fashion choice reminds people of a famous swan dress worn at the Academy Awards years ago. Interestingly, birds are also important symbols in the novel that inspired her new film. As the movie release approaches, fans can expect more stylish red carpet appearances from the star and her castmates.
paragraphs.zh: 這種以鳥類為靈感的時尚選擇讓人想起多年前在奧斯卡頒獎典禮上穿過的一件著名天鵝禮服。有趣的是，鳥類也是啟發她新電影的小說中的重要象徵。隨著電影上映日期的接近，粉絲們可以期待這位明星與她的演員同伴們在紅毯上展現更多時尚穿搭。

lessons.title: Europe leads the world on AI rules. So why is it missing from the AI safety debate?
lessons.title_zh: 歐洲引領人工智慧規則，為何卻缺席AI安全辯論？

paragraphs.en: Europe has created the world's first comprehensive set of rules to govern artificial intelligence, yet it is noticeably absent from high-level safety talks. While European lawmakers drafted the AI Act years ago to hold companies accountable, the continent now faces a severe economic and technological disadvantage.
paragraphs.zh: 歐洲制定了全球第一套全面規範人工智慧的規則，卻明顯缺席了高層安全對話。雖然歐洲立法者多年前就起草了《人工智慧法案》來要求企業負起責任，但該洲目前正面臨嚴重的經濟與技術劣勢。

paragraphs.en: The region struggles to produce tech giants and frontier models that can rival those in the United States and China. European leaders warn that the continent is at acute risk of marginalization because of this widening gap in the global AI race.
paragraphs.zh: 該地區難以培育出能與美國和中國相媲美的科技巨頭與前沿模型。歐洲領導人警告稱，由於全球AI競賽中這個日益擴大的差距，歐洲正面臨被邊緣化的急迫風險。

paragraphs.en: The European Union's strict regulations, including the AI Act, are intended to put guardrails in place and protect user data. However, the law has proven difficult to enforce, and several member states have not yet established authorities to police compliance.
paragraphs.zh: 歐盟的嚴格法規（包括《人工智慧法案》）旨在建立防護欄並保護用戶數據。然而，事實證明該法律難以執行，幾個成員國尚未建立機構來監督合規性。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, these complex regulatory systems have caused significant delays in the rollout of new AI products. Many local firms cite a lack of clarity and fear of heavy fines as major reasons for choosing not to adopt AI.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，這些複雜的監管系統導致新AI產品的推出嚴重延遲。許多當地企業指出，缺乏明確性以及對重罰的擔憂，是選擇不採用AI的主要原因。

paragraphs.en: Aside from regulation, a massive lack of private investment and infrastructure remains a major barrier. Despite these obstacles, some experts remain optimistic that Europe's deep industrial expertise will eventually help its tech industry thrive.
paragraphs.zh: 除了監管之外，私人投資與基礎設施的嚴重缺乏仍然是一大障礙。儘管存在這些阻礙，一些專家仍然保持樂觀，認為歐洲深厚的工業專業知識最終將有助於其科技產業蓬勃發展。

phrases.zh: 建立防護機制（或防護欄）

grammar.example: European leaders warn that the continent is at acute risk of marginalization because of this widening gap in the global AI race.

grammar.example: The region struggles to produce tech giants and frontier models that can rival those in the United States and China.

lessons.title: These workers help train robots who could one day steal their jobs
lessons.title_zh: 這些工人正在訓練可能有一天會搶走他們工作的機器人

paragraphs.en: In Karur, India, some textile factory workers have been told to wear GoPros while doing their daily tasks. Their hand gestures and movements are recorded to train AI robots to take over these jobs. Many workers, including a 40-year-old employee named Shoba Kirubakaran who makes ninety dollars a month, were never informed about this purpose by their companies.
paragraphs.zh: 在印度卡魯爾，一些紡織廠工人被要求在日常工作時佩戴GoPro。他們的肢體動作被錄下來，以訓練AI機器人來接管這些工作。許多工人（包括一個月賺九十美元、名叫紹芭·基魯巴卡倫的四十歲員工）從未被公司告知這個目的。

paragraphs.en: India is becoming a major hub for recording this egocentric data because of its large population and low wages. Experts explain that today's AI systems lack physical bodies and need millions of hours of real human footage to learn motor skills. While some individuals are paid hourly to collect this data, others find themselves unknowingly exploited.
paragraphs.zh: 由於人口眾多且工資相對較低，印度正成為記錄這種以自我為中心之數據的主要中心。專家解釋說，當今的AI系統缺乏實體，需要數百萬小時的真實人類影片來學習運動技能。雖然有些人是按小時計酬來收集這些數據，但其他人卻發現自己不知不覺中遭到剝削。

paragraphs.en: However, deploying robots at scale in India might not happen immediately. Experts point out that running AI robots is expensive and requires massive amounts of reliable power, which remains a challenge. Human labor is still cheaper than operating such advanced machinery in the region.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在印度大規模部署機器人可能不會立即發生。專家指出，運行AI機器人成本高昂且需要大量穩定的電力，這仍然是一大挑戰。在該地區，人力勞動仍然比操作此類先進機械便宜。

paragraphs.en: Despite these obstacles, local tech companies continue gathering data for domestic and foreign clients. Employees wear special headsets and use robot claws to record repetitive tasks, ranging from industrial packaging to household chores. As workers teach these machines how to handle different objects, some realize that their current jobs will eventually disappear.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管存在這些障礙，當地科技公司仍繼續為國內外客戶收集數據。員工佩戴特殊頭戴式裝置並使用機器人爪子來記錄重複性任務，範圍從工業包裝到家務勞動不等。隨著工人教導這些機器如何處理不同的物品，有些人意識到他們目前的工作最終將會消失。

grammar.explain: 當主詞是動作的承受者時，使用「be動詞 + 過去分詞」來表達被動關係。
grammar.example: Their hand gestures and movements are recorded to train AI robots to take over these jobs.

lessons.title: 'I applied for 200 jobs' - How 'spray and pray' AI job applications can backfire
lessons.title_zh: 「我投了兩百個職缺」—人工智慧海投履歷如何帶來反效果

paragraphs.en: Many graduates today rely on artificial intelligence to help write their resumes and cover letters. While employers generally accept this for early stages, it raises questions about ethics and cheating.
paragraphs.zh: 現今許多畢業生依賴人工智慧來協助撰寫履歷與求職信。雖然雇主普遍在初期階段接受這種做法，但這也引發了關於道德與作弊的問題。

paragraphs.en: Tom, a recent graduate, applied for more than two hundred positions before securing a role as a restaurant manager. He found the process extremely tiring and noted that using technology was necessary to handle multiple applications daily.
paragraphs.zh: 最近畢業的湯姆在找到餐廳經理的職位之前，申請了兩百多個職缺。他發現這個過程極為疲憊，並指出使用科技來處理每日多份申請是必要的。

paragraphs.en: A recent survey by the Institute of Student Employers shows that many large companies are becoming more accepting of AI for CV writing. However, ninety-two percent of employers have also encountered misconduct, such as people using real-time assistants during video interviews.
paragraphs.zh: 學生雇主協會最近的一項調查顯示，許多大公司正變得更能接受用AI來寫履歷。然而，百分之九十二的雇主也遇到了違規行為，例如有人在視訊面試期間使用即時助理。

paragraphs.en: This trend of sending massive applications simultaneously is known as spray and pray. Experts warn that this behavior increases competition and pressure for students in a tough job market.
paragraphs.zh: 這種同時大量發送申請的趨勢被稱為「廣撒網祈禱法」。專家警告說，這種行為在艱難的求職市場中增加了學生的競爭與壓力。

paragraphs.en: Some major firms have closed their recruitment windows early due to a massive surge in submissions. Companies are now issuing guidance and trying to design their hiring processes to be as resistant to artificial intelligence as possible.
paragraphs.zh: 由於應徵件數激增，一些大企業已經提前關閉了招募窗口。各公司現在正發布指導方針，並試圖將招募流程設計得盡可能不受人工智慧影響。

paragraphs.en: Despite the rise of smart tools, experts emphasize that companies ultimately value true personality and authenticity. A representative named Hollie Moody stated, "We want diversity of thought in the business."
paragraphs.zh: 儘管智慧工具崛起，專家強調公司最終仍看重真實的個人特質與原創性。一位名叫荷莉·穆迪的代表表示：「我們希望企業內有多元化的思維。」
